items.information: Competitors: Please try to bring 2 guests or fewer. **Competition Day Timing** * The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. * Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. * Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.
